notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating a 1/1 Saproling and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saproling and Squirrel, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion and Squirrel, adding {2}.
Repeat.
